noConversation: There is no such conversation in the archive.
none: No SMS archive yet. Messages are archived by the SMS app on the phone (the „sms" edition).

setup.roleAsk: Should the SMS archive belong to: {name}?
setup.roleAskThis: Should the SMS archive belong to this role?
setup.roleBody: Whoever has this role — also whoever you hand it to one day — reads the archive, also in the browser. From now on the phone archives there; the previous archive stays where it is and can still be read.
setup.roleChanged: The archive now belongs to the chosen role. „Archive now" moves the messages there.
setup.upToDate: The archive is up to date.
setup.title: Archiving
setup.noRead: This app cannot read SMS on this phone yet. On an old phone from which you only want to move the history, it doesn't need to be the SMS app — it's enough to let it read messages.
setup.ownerNote: Whoever has this role reads the archive — also in the browser. Every phone with this app (e.g. an old one) archives to the same place; the same messages from two phones are stored once.
setup.media: With photos and videos from MMS (up to 10 MB each)
setup.whole: Each chosen conversation goes into the archive in full — all the messages that are on the phone.
setup.notOn: The archive is not switched on yet: choose a role and conversations, then „Archive now" — from then on new messages arrive by themselves.
setup.auto: New ones arrive by themselves: shortly after arriving or being sent, and twice a day.
setup.progress: Conversations {done}/{of} · checked {seen} · new {added} · already in archive {known}
